_comment: Student registry. The KEY is the card UID exactly as the ESP32 prints it:
uppercase hex, no spaces, no colons (e.g. A1B2C3D4).
Read the UID from the Arduino Serial Monitor at 115200 baud, or from the
'unknown_uids.csv' file that the Node-RED flow writes for unregistered cards.
parentChatId = the Telegram chat id of the parent (get it from @userinfobot).
Delete this _comment key once you start editing for real.
